title: Reconnect with past attendees
description: Re-engage past attendees with a thank-you and a new event they may like. Re-engagement WhatsApp template. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Reference the event they attended. Personal context beats generic announcements.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we loved having you at *{{event_name}}* last time. We have something new planned for {{date}} in {{city}} and think you'll enjoy it.
